about: Pending qualifications and errata, shown with the record or note they qualify in RESULTS.md, on the site and on THEORY.md's cards. Add an entry when a later result qualifies a published one; remove it when the record is reissued or superseded, and record the change in HISTORY.md.

items.text: Qualification pending: false at 2-edge cuts, where parts meet as two-place parity, and exact only up to signs at 3-edge cuts (see NATIVE-PATHS-20261101-001).
Qualification pending: the face law fails at junctions and holds after reduction (see FACE-CLAIM-20261103-001).
Qualification pending: the law holds after reduction (see the FACE-CLAIM-20261103-001 closure).
Interpretation pending: whether counted length is a native magnitude has not been decided; read it as a count, not a distance.
Erratum pending: abstract item 5, Section 6 and Theorem 12 say the knot's spaces compose only through hubs, which is false at 2-edge cuts (see NATIVE-PATHS-20261101-001).
Qualification pending: the second sentence, on census 6, holds only in the order in which each gluing line's points are written; that atoms act as one holds natively (see GENUS-READ-20261107-001).

Qualification pending: the rule reads these spaces only with census 6 glued in the order in which each line's points are written; with census 6 counted over its three gluings, its split step cuts every atom of six or seven lines (see GENUS-READ-20261107-001).
